We need to generate high-quality unit test code for SpecVersionDetector.detect(JsonNode). Use JUnit5 and Mockito. They already have a test class framework with some tests (parameterized). We need to augment with additional test cases derived from the JSON test cases list. Must not modify @Before/@After etc. Create test methods covering groups: successful detection, missing/unknown tag, null input, non-text $schema value, known older drafts, whitespace/case variations, empty string, fragment/query, root node not an object.

We need to create JsonNode from string using ObjectMapper. The existing test class already has mapper static. We'll add more parameterized tests.

Some cases expect JsonSchemaException with message "'$schema' tag is not present". But also some test expecting NullPointerException for null input.

Note: detect method will call detectOptionalVersion(jsonNode).orElseThrow(() -> new JsonSchemaException("'$schema' tag is not present")). So if jsonNode is null, calling detectOptionalVersion(null) will likely cause NPE when accessing. So test expecting NPE.

Thus we create new methods.

We already have some tests in framework for happy path using resource files. Those maybe duplicate. We'll add new tests using inline JSON strings.

We need import JsonSchemaException, SpecVersion.VersionFlag.

We'll use @ParameterizedTest with @MethodSource perhaps easier to have custom expected types. But can also use CsvSource with expected enum names; but for failures we need message.

Better: create separate parameterized methods.

Implementation:

- testDetect_successfulVersions: parameters: json string, expected VersionFlag enum.

- testDetect_missingOrUnknownTag_throwsException: parameters: json string, expectedMessage.

- testDetect_nullInput_throwsNPE: single test.

- testDetect_nonTextSchemaValue_throwsException: similar to missing case.

- testDetect_whitespaceAndCaseVariations_throwsException.

- testDetect_schemaEmptyString_throwsException.

- testDetect_schemaWithFragmentOrQuery_throwsException.

- testDetect_rootNodeNotObject_throwsException: test multiple json types (array, number, boolean, string, null value for $schema).

We can group some using @CsvSource, but handling JSON string that contains commas may break CSV. Use @MethodSource for clarity.

Will use static Stream<Arguments> methods providing arguments.

Need to create JsonNode from string: mapper.readTree(jsonString). For null input test we pass null.

Need to assert exception message equals "'$schema' tag is not present". In JSON cases where unknown schema URI also expects same message, per spec.

Implementation details:

- For unknown schema test case: json: {"$schema":"http://example.com/unknown-schema"} -> expect exception message same.

- For non-text $schema: number, array, null should also throw same exception.

All failing cases have same message; we can just assert that.

Edge: whitespace and case variations also same.

Now implement test class.

Will need imports: org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.Arguments, java.util.stream.Stream, org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.MethodSource, com.networknt.schema.SpecVersion.VersionFlag, com.networknt.schema.JsonSchemaException.

Now produce final code.
